decision_rule: At 24bp, at least 60 completed trades, NAV>1, PF>1, median>=0, both half-years positive, and exact positive-event deletion/full reroute NAV>1; unchanged 2023 must repeat before ML or official opens.

event.displacement: within next four completed 15m bars; reversal body/ATR above 2021 prior-only median; closes through latest causal width-two 15m internal swing; raid extreme intact
event.protected_origin: body of last completed opposite-direction 15m candle from raid through displacement
event.raid: first completed 15m trade-through and close back on pre-pool side

execution.market_resolution: first fully later observed one-minute open for response; causal one-tick-through limit for midpoint
execution.same_minute_ambiguity: adverse stop first; no favorable target in intraminute limit-fill minute because pre-fill ordering is unknown
execution.stage_boundary: mark unresolved exposure and retain slot; never strategy-close

logic.smc_terms_are_not_gates: No FVG/OTE/session/asset-specific rescue; the origin is the last actual opposite 15m body in the raid-to-displacement sequence and is never substituted.
logic.thesis: Pre-known external liquidity is raided and rejected; reversal displacement through causal internal structure forms a protected origin; the first return should redeliver toward a still-unconsumed scale-consistent external draw while the raid extreme remains intact.

purpose: Fatal deterministic screen of the transcript-grounded claim that an origin formed while consuming pre-known external liquidity is protected on its first return.
